non_blocking_notes: Vacuity probe on the delivered assertion: on a scratch copy of the worktree under /tmp (never inside the worktree), appending a module-level `def source_metadata()` to src/rivretrieve/__init__.py makes the affected test fail, but it fails at the PRE-EXISTING exact-name-set assertion ('Extra items in the left set: source_metadata'), not at the new line. The new assertion's independent discriminating power was proven separately: appending a module-level `__getattr__` that dynamically returns `source_metadata` leaves the exact-set assertion green (a dynamic attribute is absent from vars()) and fails precisely at tests/test_package.py:37 `assert not hasattr(rivretrieve, "source_metadata")` with 'assert not True'. The new assertion is therefore non-vacuous and adds coverage the existing assertion did not have, exactly as the plan's section 4 predicts.
Both mutation probes were paired with an acceptance probe on the same scratch build with the mutation removed, which passed (1 passed in 0.01s).

Gates re-measured in the worktree, all green: `uv run ruff format --check` -> '162 files already formatted' (exit 0, the non-mutating form required by binding repository knowledge #6); `uv run ruff check` (no --fix) -> 'All checks passed!'; `uv run ty check src` -> 'All checks passed!'; `uv run pytest` -> '1622 passed, 2 skipped', matching the plan's acceptance baseline exactly.

Harness environment caveat, not an artifact defect: the first full-suite run through the harness inherited no PATH, and tests/test_internal_engine_contracts.py::test_obsolete_window_symbols_are_absent_from_tracked_source and ::test_fetch_window_is_rejected_where_requested_window_is_required failed with FileNotFoundError: 'uv' because they shell out to uv. Re-running the identical command with PATH supplied yielded the clean 1622/2 baseline. Nothing in the artifact causes this.
`uv build` on a fresh scratch copy exits 0 and produces rivretrieve-0.1.49.tar.gz and rivretrieve-0.1.49-py3-none-any.whl, confirming acceptance criterion 6 with no version change.

Scope and prohibited-edit checks all pass: `git diff --name-only base...head` reports exactly `tests/test_package.py`; the diff is a single added line with no deletion, loosening, skip, xfail, or changed expected value anywhere in the test suite; no ignore/noqa/type-ignore or pytest marker was added; pyproject.toml, ruff/ty configuration, uv.lock, .pce/repository-contract.json, and tests/typecheck/nominal_window_misuse.py are all untouched, so the typecheck gate remains scoped to src. There is no configuration entry this change adds that could be deleted to make a check vacuous.

Commit hygiene verified: exactly one commit above the base with subject `test: exclude source_metadata from the public surface`, an empty body with no attribution footers, `git show --name-only` listing only tests/test_package.py, `git tag --points-at HEAD` empty, and `git status --porcelain=v1` showing only `?? pr-body.md` (present at the worktree root and untracked, as required).

Claim honesty: pr-body.md matches plan section 5 byte-for-byte in content and makes three claims, each supported by measurement rather than by assertion. 'codify that source_metadata is absent' — `git grep source_metadata HEAD` returns exactly one hit, the new assertion at tests/test_package.py:37, so no production occurrence exists. 'preserve the existing three-verbs-and-a-selection API and four-field packaged catalogue artifact' — measured at runtime: the non-underscore name set is exactly the ten names the plan requires, dataclasses.fields(PackagedCatalogArtifact) is ['provider_info', 'products', 'stations', 'station_products'], REQUIRED_ARTIFACT_FILES is the four required files, and hasattr(rivretrieve, 'source_metadata') is False. 'leave runtime code, catalogue data, and packaging configuration unchanged' — supported by the single-file diff. pr-body.md states no figures, so there was no stated number to re-measure.

The worktree was left tracked-clean: `git status --porcelain=v1 --untracked-files=no` returns empty. All mutation work was done on rsync copies under /tmp. An early probe that tried to shadow the package via PYTHONPATH was discarded as invalid rather than reported, because pytest's `pythonpath = ["src"]` setting takes precedence and the probe could not have detected a real defect.
summary: The built artifact delivers its approved plan and I could not demonstrate a break. The tracked change is exactly the one authorised line, `assert not hasattr(rivretrieve, "source_metadata")`, added to tests/test_package.py after the unchanged exact-name-set assertion; every other assertion in that test and in the suite is byte-identical, and no production, catalogue, packaging, contract, or gate-configuration file is touched. I proved the new assertion is not decorative rather than merely reading it: on scratch copies outside the worktree, a module-level `__getattr__` that dynamically supplies source_metadata passes the pre-existing exact-set assertion and fails at the new line, while the same build without the mutation passes. All gates were re-measured green in the worktree (ruff format --check, ruff check without --fix, ty check src, and the full suite at the plan's exact 1622 passed / 2 skipped baseline), uv build produces the unchanged 0.1.49 sdist and wheel, and commit hygiene matches the plan: one conventional commit, no attribution footer, no tag, pr-body.md present at the worktree root and untracked with contents matching section 5. blocking_issues is empty because no probe produced a demonstrated break.
